stem: What are all the real solutions to the equation \(x^{4} - 81 = 0\)?
solution: Factor as a difference of squares: \((x^{2} - 9)(x^{2} + 9) = 0\).
\(x^{2} - 9 = 0\) gives \(x = 3\) or \(x = -3\); \(x^{2} + 9 = 0\) has no real solutions.

explanation.A: Incorrect. This misses the negative solution: \((-3)^{4} = 81\) as well.
explanation.B: Incorrect. These solve \(x^{2} = 81\); this takes the square root only once, but \(x^{4} = 81\) needs a fourth root.
explanation.C: Incorrect. \(9\) and \(-9\) are not solutions, since \(9^{4} = 6{,}561\).
